For electronics like this, seller trust matters a lot for authenticity and actually honoring the returns/warranty.

If budget is your #1 priority and you're comfortable with a bit more risk, Seller A saves you money for the same stated product and policies. But if you want the safer buy, go with Ottervale Audio.
